reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001309 (the melody read from 001309a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 21); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Georg Hille has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1730, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001309a.nwc).
